verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud (a SaaS platform, not itself an agent), so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. It documents only an OpenAI-compatible API, and probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs, or OpenAPI spec. Absent evidence for an applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
